Ivy (Design): Heads-up: metric cards on the Console are jittering at ~950px. When the overflow kebab appears the primary button moves and toasts pop under the sticky header. Screenshot attached. Do we tweak spacing tokens or reserve space for actions?
Noah: I can repro on FF. Grid goes 3->2 columns then card width drops and actions reflow. My vote: token adjustment first.
Felix (A11y): Accessibility points: 1) focus can drift offscreen after the layout jump; 2) toasts are currently aria-hidden in some builds. Use role="status" and aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce them.
Ivy (Design): Thinking: between 720-1000px swap inline gap from `space-6` to `space-5`. If issues persist, reserve `min-inline-size` for `.card-actions` and collapse labels to icon-only under 720px.
June (Frontend): Token swap is easiest to implement. CSS prototype: ```@media (max-width:1000px){ :root{ --card-gap-inline: var(--space-5); } }``` Toast offset fix: `top: calc(var(--nav-height) + var(--space-2))`.
Noah: If we reserve width, ensure long labels don't truncate awkwardly. Maybe icon-only + tooltip is better for very narrow cards.
Felix (A11y): If label hidden, ensure `aria-label` exists and tooltips include the full label + shortcut if any. Also increase focus ring thickness to 2px and use high-contrast focus color; we had a regression with a thin muted ring.
June (Frontend): Will prototype token-swap + toast offset and add aria-label on collapsed buttons. Also will make toasts announce only once (container with role=status).
design-bot: Created DR task https://redwood.internal/tasks/DR-478 for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
Ivy (Design): Action list: 1) June to prototype token swap + toast changes 2) I will mock reserved-width vs icon-collapse states 3) Felix will run SR/keyboard checks on the prototype 4) Noah to test truncation with long labels.
Noah: I'll test with long names and right-to-left labels as an extra check.
June (Frontend): I'll open a small PR with the CSS change and aria updates today.
Ivy (Design): Thanks all — aiming for next sprint. Ping me here with edge cases. :sparkles:
